1.

The Lord comes! Saints, raise Joyfully a song of jubilation! Soon in the clouds we shall behold Him, The wait will not be long. The Lord comes! What we believed Shall become a reality; The perishable shall be changed into Imperishability.

2.

Christ, with a single offering, Has perfected us. He has reconciled us with His God, Himself was the offering; For His blood avails more Than our multitude of sins. He who died is now risen, The gate of death is broken.

3.

Never can we be condemned, For His precious wounds Before God cannot be forgotten, Where no judgment reaches us. He has given us His glory, Is it truly so? Yes, as a token He has given us The Spirit’s earnest.

4.

Therefore His coming gladdens us, Sweet, blessed hope! The heart now in joyful expectation Looks constantly upward. Soon the Lord’s voice shall be heard, He Himself shall appear, And His bride with joy shall gather Through the clouds.
